text:
sophia: Kicking off a controlled canary for service-x. Enabling feature flag `new-routing` for 5% cohort starting now. Will watch latency, 5xx, and token-p95. :eyes:
release-bot: [deploy-job 6512349999] queued: canary rollout for service-x, tag=v2.3.1, ff:new-routing=5% (initiated by sophia)
jamie.ops: 👍 what's the preflight checklist? any holdpoints?
sophia: preflight done — smoke, infra health, infra autoscale checks. Holdpoint at 15m for metrics review. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/service-x-canary
chen: heads up — pinning behavior for routing requires version pin on router-proxy if we exceed 20% traffic. otherwise it auto-fanout.
andre: noted. can we add a soft backpressure rule in the deploybot in case latency goes > 400ms p95?
sophia: yes. adding a throttling rule now. config snippet: ```json
{
  "backpressure": {"p95_ms": 400, "action": "attenuate_cohort_by_50pct"},
  "watch_metrics": ["latency_p95","5xx_rate","error_spike"]
}
```
release-bot: [deploy-job 6512349999] running canary -> cohort=5% allocated
sophia: starting traffic slice 5% -> 12:03 UTC
jamie.ops: watching traces and dashboards. tagging this thread for oncall: @ryan.oncall
ryan.oncall: oncall ack. I'll watch SLOs and be ready to mute if noisy. How long till next bump?
sophia: planned ramp to 20% at +10m if stable. holdpoint at +15m for manual approval to 50%.
release-bot: [metric-update] 12:08 UTC: latency_p95=192ms, 5xx=0.02%, request_rate stable
chen: nothing alarming in logs. small increase in tail lat due to new KV cache miss pattern but within SLA.
andre: deploying soft vent policy to rate-limiter to allow gradual increase: `/ops/rate-limit vent --service service-x --staged 10,20`
sophia: bumping to 20% now. release-bot: [deploy-job 6512349999] cohort updated -> 20%
release-bot: [metric-update] 12:14 UTC: latency_p95=220ms, 5xx=0.05%
jamie.ops: p95 drifting but under threshold. continuing to monitor.
release-bot: [metric-update] 12:17 UTC: 5xx spike -> 0.9% (rolling window: 5m) :warning:
andre: spike visible. rolling logs show surge on upstream v2.3.1 model routing. tagging model-team.
maria-exec: pinging model-team for visibility, keep me posted if rollback needed.
sophia: decision time — do we throttle cohort or rollback? what's impact to user traffic if we soft-drain?
ryan.oncall: recommend immediate attenuation to 5% and take a canary snapshot. If errors continue -> rollback to v2.3.0 pinned.
jamie.ops: I can run attenuation now. `/deploybot attenuate --job 6512349999 --to 5% --reason "5xx spike"`
release-bot: [action] attenuation queued by jamie.ops
release-bot: [deploy-job 6512349999] cohort updated -> 5% (attenuated)
release-bot: [metric-update] 12:21 UTC: 5xx back down to 0.12%, latency_p95=205ms
sophia: Good. We're stable but model routing still has anomaly patterns. Recommend rollback to v2.3.0 for router-proxy to be safe. Any objections?
chen: no objections. rollback steps: pin router-proxy to v2.3.0 and redeploy proxies, confirm KV cache warmup.
andre: I'll prepare a rollout plan for rollback: `pin->gradual-unwind->monitor->unpin if healthy`
jamie.ops: ready to execute rollback on approval. syntax: `release-bot rollback --service router-proxy --to-tag v2.3.0 --reason "canary 5xx spike"`
sophia: do it.
release-bot: [action] rollback initiated by sophia
release-bot: [rollback-job 6512350001] router-proxy -> v2.3.0 starting
release-bot: [rollback-job 6512350100] router-proxy -> v2.3.0 applied to 50%
release-bot: [rollback-job 6512350200] router-proxy -> v2.3.0 fully applied
release-bot: [metric-update] 12:35 UTC: 5xx=0.03%, latency_p95=180ms
ryan.oncall: confirming SLOs back to normal. Good rollback. Recommend keep flag at 5% hold until model-team provides a patch.
sophia: agreed. setting `new-routing` to cohort=5% hold. Will also open a JIRA for model-team with logs and trace links.
chen: adding postmortem notes to runbook. quick dev tasks: investigate KV cache sequence and model routing mismatch.
maria-exec: thanks team — appreciate quick attenuation + rollback. Please add short summary to release notes.
sophia: summary for release notes: "new-routing flag enabled -> canary 5% -> extended to 20% -> 5xx spike observed -> attenuated to 5% -> rollback of router-proxy to v2.3.0 -> stability restored. Holding flag at 5% pending model fix."
jamie.ops: leaving post-deploy checklist: 1) monitor for 60m, 2) disable ramp automation, 3) schedule model fix deploy window.
ryan.oncall: I'll keep an eye overnight. Marking this thread resolved unless someone needs follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: [note] ticket #OPS-1421 opened for rollback follow-up and metric dashboard snapshots attached
sophia: thanks all.
